notes.title: Mirror Of Life Chapter 1 METRO
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2mXrSZNzbT8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Chapter 1 released[/h2]
A detective is assigned to solve a murder committed in the subway. But he can't solve the murder for a long time. Everything changes one day when a person whom he does not know leads him. In this story, you are the detective. You have to research everything very carefully. You should examine the evidence you find very carefully. You have to be very careful as there will be a consequence of the choice you make. What are you waiting for, there is an unsolved murder. Isn't it time to figure this out?
[h2]Episode information[/h2]
New episodes will be added to the game constantly, this is the first episode to be published. Each episode can tell a different story. There may be links between stories.
